subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit full-path mode?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally preserve compact home markers, recent fixes deliberately repaired only corrupted sibling-prefix output, and changing the contract affects UX, privacy, documentation, and possible config surface.

options.title: Keep compact default
options.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default display contract while continuing to fix only corrupted or non-copyable rewrites.

options.title: Switch default to full paths
options.body: Make agent-visible path output use full absolute paths everywhere and update shared helpers, prompts, docs, and regression tests together.

options.title: Add full-path mode
options.body: Keep compact display by default but add a documented opt-in mode for users who need full paths, with tests proving both modes.

recommendation.title: Keep compact default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default display contract while continuing to fix only corrupted or non-copyable rewrites.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared helper history and recent session-memory path-display repair make this the strongest routing owner for the product contract choice.
